sources.title: PowerAim — AI aim alignment for Windows
sources.snippet: AI aim alignment · .NET 10 · 100% local Lock on. Stay smooth. PowerAim runs a real-time YOLOv8 model on your screen and nudges the aim toward the target — with persistent multi-target tracking, adaptive smoothing, gamepad output, OCR triggers and an LLM-driven AutoPlay. Free, source-available, no key system.
